name: Korean Start Deck 100 Battle Collection Mini League completion prize
short: Korean Start Deck 100 Battle Collection Mini League completion prize

description.text: Mini leagues played with a MEGA Start Deck 100 Battle Collection deck bought and opened on the spot, three Swiss rounds with no changes to the deck allowed. Players who finished all three rounds got 032/M-P Poké Pad, stamped with the Start Deck 100 logo. The league ran at the 2026 Korean League Season 3 in Gwangju on 7 and 8 March 2026, then at ten Pokémon Card Shops from 21 March to 10 May 2026 and again at Season 4 and the Final Season.
